snippet.title: Cozy Island Cleaner - Collect Trash & Florish the Island - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Cozy Island Cleaner is a relaxing cleaning game where you bring a trash-covered island back to life. Start by picking up one bottle at a time, end up hauling it away by the truckload, with a robot bin, a grinder, and a cat helping out along the way.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5112580/Cozy_Island_Cleaner/
